<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bikkurim 3:3:17">Y. Bicc. III, 65ᵈ</cite> top <he>מתמני בכ׳</he> appointed to office for money.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 87a:13">B. Kam. 87ᵃ</cite> <he>אפחתה מכַּסְפָּהּ</he> Ms. M. he lessened her value; a. fr.—Pl. <he>כַּסְפַּיָּיא</he>.

<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 42:25">Targ. Gen. XLII, 25</cite>; <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 42:35">35</cite>.—Y. Bicc. l. c. <he>לא בכ׳ אתמני</he> was it not through gifts of money that he was appointed?
